paper.citation: Calonico, S., Cattaneo, M. D., and Farrell, M. H. (2018). On the Effect of Bias Estimation on Coverage Accuracy in Nonparametric Inference. Journal of the American Statistical Association 113(522), 767-779. DOI: 10.1080/01621459.2017.1285776.
paper.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
paper.source_locator: Supplement S.II.7 (Complete Simulation Results), printed p.80, PDF p.81: data-generating process Y=m(X)+eps, X~U[-1,1], eps~N(0,1), and Models 1-6 with regression functions. Main text Section 4 (Simulation Results), printed p.776, PDF p.10: representative Model 5 and the evaluation grid x in {-2/3,-1/3,0,1/3,2/3}.

mechanism.name: Nonparametric regression with linear mean and Gaussian bump: CCF2018 Models 2 and 4

generation_equations.label: DGP structure
generation_equations.expression: Y = m(X) + eps,  X ~ U[-1,1],  eps ~ N(0,1)  independently of X

generation_equations.label: Estimand (fixed query point)
generation_equations.expression: m(x0) = E[Y | X = x0]  at  x0 = 0

assumptions: iid observations; X is independent of the noise eps
eps ~ N(0,1) with mean zero, so E[Y|X=x0] = m(x0) is deterministic and known in closed form
m(x) is smooth (infinitely differentiable) on [-1,1]; the Gaussian bump creates high curvature near x=0
Pointwise inference at a single fixed query point x0=0; this is not a simultaneous confidence band over the paper's evaluation grid {-2/3,-1/3,0,1/3,2/3}
No causal interpretation; this is a nonparametric regression inference (NRI) task with no treatment, mediator, or intervention

properties.notes: Univariate nonparametric regression (dimension=1, effective_dimension=1: one covariate X fully determines the conditional mean). Nonlinearity from the Gaussian bump: Model 2 adds 2*exp(-64*x^2) to a linear term 2x; Model 4 adds 5*phi(10x) to a linear term x. The bump is centered at x=0 with effective width ~1/8 (M2) and ~1/10 (M4). Away from the bump, m(x) is nearly linear. No interactions, no high-dimensional structure, no irrelevant padding.

estimand.name: m(x0) = E[Y | X = x0]
estimand.definition: Conditional mean of Y given X = x0 at the fixed query point x0 = 0, in the superpopulation defined by the DGP Y = m(X) + eps, X ~ U[-1,1], eps ~ N(0,1). Models 2 and 4 from supplement S.II.7 are collected as two scenarios of the same mechanism family; both are linear-plus-Gaussian-bump regression functions.

parameters.description: Linear plus Gaussian bump from CCF2018 supplement S.II.7 Model 2: m(x)=2x+2*exp(-64x^2)

truth.expression: Conditional mean of Y given X = x0 at the fixed query point x0 = 0, in the superpopulation defined by the DGP Y = m(X) + eps, X ~ U[-1,1], eps ~ N(0,1). Models 2 and 4 from supplement S.II.7 are collected as two scenarios of the same mechanism family; both are linear-plus-Gaussian-bump regression functions.
truth.derivation: Direct analytic evaluation of m(x0): both models have closed-form regression functions. Model 2 at x0=0: m(0) = 2*exp(0) = 2. Model 4 at x0=0: m(0) = 5*phi(0) = 5/sqrt(2*pi). Two independent arithmetic routes (math.exp vs ** operator; composed vs decomposed phi) confirm machine-precision agreement.
